otclient_modules.game_screenshot_otui.tr: Abra a pasta de capturas de tela
Selecione todos os eventos que devem acionar capturas de tela automáticas:

[EN] Enable this option to save screenshots of the most important
moments of your Tibia career! Whenever one of the events you
have selected takes place, a screenshot will be taken
automatically.

The following events can be selected to trigger an auto screenshot:

- Level Up: Your character has reached the next level
- Skill Up: You advanced in one of your skills (e.g. Magic Level
or Sword Fighting)
- Achievement: You earned an achievement, either while
playing or upon login
- Bestiary Entry Unlocked: You unlocked new information
about a creature in the Bestiary
- Bestiary Entry Completed: You unlocked all information about
a creature in the Bestiary
- Treasure Found: You received some reward from a container
for solving a quest or a riddle
- Valuable Loot: You just found some loot which you have
marked in the Drop Tracker
- Boss Defeated: You defeated a boss monster, either alone or
together with other players, and are entitled to loot it
- Death PvE: You were just killed by some creature (PvE)
- Death PvP: You were just killed by another player (PvP)
- Player Kill: You defeated another player
- Player Killer Assist: You assisted the killing of another player
- Player Attacking: Another player just started to attack you
- Highest Damage Dealt: You dealt a new all-time high damage
on a foe. To see or reset your current all-time high, check
the Impact Analyser
- Highest Healing Done: You healed someone with a new all-
time high healing value. To see or reset your current all-time
high, check the Impact Analyser
- Low Health: You have reached a threshold of deep red
health Copy

Se você marcar esta opção, o cliente fará uma captura de tela a cada
segundo e armazena em cache os últimos 5 deles. Sempre que uma captura de tela é
tirada automaticamente para um evento selecionado ou manualmente usando um
tecla de atalho, também as capturas de tela dos 5 segundos anteriores serão
salvo.
Se você tiver falhas de quadros, considere desativar
essa opção..
Mantenha o Blacklog das capturas de tela dos últimos 5 segundos

Se você marcar esta opção, as capturas de tela serão tiradas apenas de
a janela do jogo em vez da interface completa do cliente. Isto
pode melhorar o desempenho do seu jogo, especialmente se você tiver
marcou a opção Screenshot Backlog.
Somente janela de captura do jogo

 currently active on the right side of the entry line of the chat console.Press this button to switch between the two chat modes.
Of course, you can also set a hotkey to toggle between Chat On and Off.
- Chat On
In this mode, you will be able to write text in the entry line of the chat console.
However, if you have assigned an action to a letter key, the action will be triggered.
- Chat On*
This is the temporary Chat On mode.
In the default hotkey preset, the Return key switches between Chat Off and this mode.
If the chat mode is off and you press this hotkey, it temporarily activates the chat mode so that you can write one message in the console.
As soon as you press Return to send the message, your chat mode will be set to Chat Off again so that you can continue walking with WASD, for example.
- Chat Off
In this mode, you will not be able to write any text in the entry line of the console, but you can use your predefined hotkeys to walk or cast spells, for example.
You can assign functions to all keys of your keyboard, e.g. walk with WASD.
